package com.acme.shipping.label;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.EnumMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Builds carrier shipping labels.
 *
 * <p>CR-4471: dangerous-goods marking and the oversize surcharge note.
 */
public class LabelService {

    static final int MAX_WEIGHT_GRAMS = 30_000;
    static final int OVERSIZE_CM = 150;
    private static final String RETURN_ADDRESS = "21 Changi North Way; Singapore 498774";

    private final Clock clock;
    private final Map<Carrier, String> carrierPrefixes = new EnumMap<>(Carrier.class);

    public LabelService(final Clock clock) {
        this.clock = clock;
        carrierPrefixes.put(Carrier.ACME_POST, "AP");
        carrierPrefixes.put(Carrier.SPEEDY, "SX");
        carrierPrefixes.put(Carrier.LEGACY, "LG");
    }

    public Label create(final Shipment shipment) {
        validate(shipment);
        final String prefix = carrierPrefixes.get(shipment.carrier());
        final TrackingNumber tracking = TrackingNumber.next(prefix, LocalDate.now(clock));
        final List<String> lines = new ArrayList<>();
        lines.add(shipment.recipientName().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
        lines.addAll(shipment.addressLines());
        lines.add(shipment.postalCode() + " " + shipment.countryCode());
        if (shipment.dangerousGoods()) {
            lines.add("DG: " + shipment.unNumber());
            lines.add("HANDLE WITH CARE");
        }
        if (isOversize(shipment)) {
            lines.add("OVERSIZE - SURCHARGE APPLIES");
        }
        return new Label(tracking, lines, shipment.weightGrams());
    }

    boolean isOversize(final Shipment shipment) {
        final int longest = Math.max(shipment.lengthCm(), Math.max(shipment.widthCm(), shipment.heightCm()));
        return longest > OVERSIZE_CM || shipment.lengthCm() + shipment.widthCm() + shipment.heightCm() > 300;
    }

    private void validate(final Shipment shipment) {
        if (shipment.weightGrams() <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("weight must be positive");
        }
        if (shipment.weightGrams() > MAX_WEIGHT_GRAMS) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("parcel exceeds " + MAX_WEIGHT_GRAMS + " g");
        }
        if (shipment.dangerousGoods() && (shipment.unNumber() == null || shipment.unNumber().isBlank())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("UN number required for dangerous goods");
        }
    }

    /** Renders the label as ZPL II for 4x6 in (812 x 1218 dots) thermal printers. */
    public String zpl(final Label label) {
        final StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(1024);
        sb.append("^XA^CI28^PW812^LL1218^LH0,0");
        sb.append(String.format("^FO%d,%d^GB%d,%d,%d^FS", 20, 20, 772, 1178, 4));
        sb.append(String.format("^FO%d,%d^A0N,%d,%d^FD%s^FS", 40, 40, 30, 30, "FROM: ACME LOGISTICS"));
        sb.append(String.format("^FO%d,%d^A0N,%d,%d^FD%s^FS", 40, 80, 24, 24, RETURN_ADDRESS));
        sb.append(String.format("^FO%d,%d^A0N,%d,%d^FD%s^FS", 600, 40, 60, 60, label.tracking().value().substring(0, 2)));
        sb.append(String.format("^FO%d,%d^GB%d,%d,%d^FS", 20, 130, 772, 0, 4));
        int y = 160;
        for (String line : label.lines()) {
            sb.append(String.format("^FO%d,%d^A0N,%d,%d^FH^FD%s^FS", 40, y, 44, 44, escape(line)));
            y += 56;
        }
        sb.append(String.format("^FO%d,%d^GB%d,%d,%d^FS", 20, y + 10, 772, 0, 4));
        sb.append(String.format("^FO%d,%d^A0N,%d,%d^FDWEIGHT: %d g^FS", 40, y + 30, 30, 30, label.weightGrams()));
        sb.append(String.format("^FO%d,%d^A0N,%d,%d^FDSHIP DATE: %s^FS", 400, y + 30, 30, 30, LocalDate.now(clock)));
        sb.append(String.format("^FO%d,%d^GB%d,%d,%d^FS", 20, y + 250, 772, 0, 4));
        sb.append(String.format("^FO%d,%d^A0N,%d,%d^FDCARRIER: %s^FS", 40, y + 270, 24, 24, label.tracking().value().substring(0, 2)));
        sb.append(String.format("^FO%d,%d^BY%d^BCN,%d,Y,N,N^FD%s^FS", 60, y + 80, 3, 160, label.tracking().value()));
        sb.append(String.format("^FO%d,%d^BQN,%d,%d^FDQA,%s^FS", 560, y + 300, 2, 6, label.tracking().value()));
        sb.append("^PQ1,0,1,Y^XZ");
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static String escape(final String text) {
        return text.replace("^", "_5E").replace("~", "_7E");
    }
}
